messages.subject: geom_point size and colour and different axis limits with facet
parts:
Dear list members,

2 questions:

I want to do a type of balloon plot with geom_point to show different size regarding a continuous variable for farms located at different locations (I am using geographic coordinates).

1. Is it possible to control for size and color  by a continuous variable in the geom_point?

p = ggplot(geo1, aes(x, y))
p + geom_point(aes(size = md)) + scale_size(name = "Indice", breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 50))

2. Is it possible to set 2 different limits in the x axis working with facet?

Thank you very much in advance.

Manuel

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: geom_point size and colour and different axis limits with facet
parts:
Hi Manuel:

Are you trying to coordinate the colors and sizes in the same legend? If so, then you need to give both scales the same name and the same set of breaks (Hadley mentioned this the other day in another post.)  Does this work?

p <- ggplot(geo1, aes(x = x, y = y, size = md, colour = md))
p + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~ sitio, scales = 'free') +
#    theme_bw() +
scale_colour_gradientn(name = 'Indice', colours = topo.colors(9),

opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size = 8, vjust = 1)) +
    opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size = 8, hjust = 1))

Uncomment the line with theme_bw() if you want a white background instead.

HTH,
Dennis
